description: Micro-tune the accepted n512 accurate and fast sytrd panel kernels that profile at 25.15 plus 5.19 ms: overlap row-tile movement and lane exchange with aligned cp.async or guarded TMA double buffering, and test a full-warp coalesced reflector/V/W epilogue while preserving exact-order accurate arithmetic, the selected cutoff, persistent correction pipeline, certificates, fallbacks, other routes, and CUDA guards.

The full-warp n512 epilogue source could not reach compilation because the focused parent NCU run left the worktree-local .torch_ext/eigh_xsyev_batched_ext/cuda.cu root-owned; torch load_inline failed with PermissionError before nvcc. No metric was produced and the source was not changed after the failure.

Reworked the n512 panel_w-null epilogue so each warp owns one trailing row: lanes 0-15 emit W and lanes 16-31 emit V as one contiguous 32-float transaction, lanes 0-15 duplicate W into the final triplet segment, and the reflector beta convention is preserved. Other panel instantiations retain their original epilogue. Build and kernelguard pass; validation is 39/39. Metric is 27343.408 us versus parent replay 27299.360. Dense/mixed/rankdef/LAPACK-even n512 are 57746.858/102389.521/95802.892/56156.021 us versus 57512.906/102033.926/95545.759/55792.277. Nsys measures accurate/fast panel totals at 25.181/5.379 ms versus parent 25.155/5.193 ms, so the full-warp row ownership adds about 0.212 ms while preserving 48 registers/thread and two-block residency.

Replaced each n512 A*v dot with two 256-row halves and double-buffered aligned K=8 shared stages. Eight-lane 4-byte cp.async groups fully occupy 32-byte sectors, next tiles overlap exact-order shared FMAs, and the 16 KiB added shared storage preserves two-block residency and 48 registers/thread. Build and kernelguard pass; validation is 39/39 with unchanged n512 residuals. Metric is 30690.856 us; dense/mixed/rankdef/LAPACK-even n512 are 91187.253/135607.547/129310.150/89413.142 us. Nsys measures accurate/fast panels at 54.159/9.717 ms versus parent 25.155/5.193 ms, quantifying about 33.5 ms of added block-barrier/shared-stage overhead despite the coalesced asynchronous loads.

Fast n512 panel dot route assigns one full warp per row for 32-lane coalesced matrix loads and warp reduction while preserving the accurate 8-lane path exactly. Kernelguard clean and 39/39 validation passed, but dense n512 regressed to 62000.736 us and aggregate metric to 28001.367 versus parent 27299.360 because five reduction shuffles and lower row concurrency outweighed sector savings.

Preserved the original 64-row/8-lane dot decomposition while lanes streamed aligned 32-byte sectors, accumulated the same logical strided subsequences, and rotated accumulators once before the unchanged 4/2/1 reduction. Kernelguard clean and 39/39 validation passed, but dense n512 regressed to 68044.449 us and metric to 28478.243; certificate changes and roughly 10 ms dense/mixed/rankdef increases suggest the remap perturbed the persistent correction trajectory.

Repacked the n512 null-panel triplet epilogue as two adjacent rows per warp: eight lanes per half load W/V, four lanes receive duplicate W via four shuffles, and twelve aligned float4 stores replace three scalar store instructions; reflector and non-null panel routes remain unchanged. Kernelguard clean and 39/39 validation passed. Exact repeat metrics 27329.735 and 27330.014 confirm a small regression versus parent 27299.360; dense n512 was 57571/57648 us.

Kept trial 5's aligned float4 triplet store but replaced four W-duplication shuffles with direct shared-memory W reloads in lanes 8-11. Kernelguard clean and 39/39 validation passed. Repeat metrics 27338.118 and 27329.144 remain a small regression/no improvement against parent 27299.360; dense n512 measured 57704 and 57572 us.

Kept the parent's scalar triplet mapping but stopped the separate reflector epilogue at update_tail and emitted trailing reflector entries from the already-loaded triplet V value, preserving beta convention, non-null panel behavior, and all panel arithmetic. Kernelguard clean and 39/39 validation passed. Repeat metrics 27301.384 and 27307.547 are near parent 27299.360; targeted dense n512 improved from parent 57512.906 to 57473.728/57491.692 us, while mixed/rankdef movement was noisy and offset aggregate benefit.

Added n512-only warp-private double-buffered 32-column row stages: every lane issues an aligned 16-byte cp.async for four rows, shared columns are bank-swizzled, wait_group 1 overlaps the next stage, and logical 8-lane sums rotate back before the unchanged reduction. No block-wide staging barrier was added; non-n512 routes are compiled through the original loop. Kernelguard clean and 39/39 validation passed with parent n512 residuals, but dense/mixed/rankdef/LAPACK-even rose to 62450/107113/100474/60786 us and metric 27856.279, so async/shared overhead still exceeds saved load traffic.

Doubled the warp-private cp.async stage from 32 to 64 columns: each lane copies two aligned float4 values, eight exact-order FMA sectors amortize each commit/wait, and 98.6 KiB dynamic shared memory retains two-block residency. Kernelguard clean and 39/39 validation passed with parent n512 residuals. Dense n512 improved from trial 8's 62450 to 58287 us but remains behind parent 57513; metric 27385.984. A 128-column four-row double buffer would exceed two-block shared residency, so this bounds the viable staged widths.

Restored trial 7's fused reflector path and manually unrolled the n512 direct row dot two iterations so two matrix/vector operand pairs load before the same ordered FMAs; all other sizes kept the original loop. Kernelguard clean and 39/39 validation passed with parent n512 residuals, but dense/mixed/rankdef/LAPACK-even regressed to 63747/108351/102016/62154 us and metric 28029.161, showing the explicit pairing worsens the compiler schedule/dependency window.

Final candidate restores the exact trial 7 tree: parent dot arithmetic and shared footprint, with only trailing reflector stores fused into the existing scalar triplet loop so the already-loaded V value is reused; beta convention, non-null panel route, cutoff, correction pipeline, certificates, and guards remain unchanged. Final build and kernelguard pass; 39/39 validation passes with parent n512 residuals. Repeat final metrics 27303.183 and 27313.233 versus parent replay 27299.360 establish statistical neutrality/slight aggregate regression; targeted n512 movements remain within error bars.

Final commit ba5dd15a4 retains only fused n512 trailing reflector emission: the existing triplet loop reuses its loaded V value and preserves beta convention, accurate/fast arithmetic, cutoff, correction pipeline, all certificates/fallbacks/routes/guards, and original shared footprint. Final build and kernelguard pass; validation 39/39. Repeat final metrics are 27303.183 and 27313.233 versus parent replay 27299.360, statistically neutral/slightly negative overall. Final nsys measures accurate/fast panels at 25.111/5.189 ms (30.299 total) versus parent 25.155/5.193 ms (30.348), a repeatable ~49 us panel reduction. Aligned direct lane rotation improved sector utilization 17.1/32 to 31.8/32 bytes but lost the parent's 46% overlapping-sector L1 hits and regressed; block and warp-private cp.async staging, full-warp/vector epilogues, fast full-warp rows, and paired operand prefetch all measured slower and are preserved in trial history.
